title: Reset worker record
summary: Recover the 0x4909e0 worker-record reset and its reference-range release behavior. The first two cursors reset before releases; four more cursors and selected state fields reset afterward.
test_description: Compare original and recovered code on empty and populated ranges, null and duplicate references, zero-count wraparound, and a release callback that changes the range beginning. Compare all record and object bytes, callback order and arguments, entries, cursor updates and FS head; check state visible during release.
known_limits: The record and reference object field names and semantic ownership are unresolved.
Only valid 32-bit layouts and normal returning callbacks are tested; invalid ranges, exceptions and actual object destruction are outside the controlled tests.
The void routine's incidental register return value is not modeled.
